rooms.name: Mossgate Square
rooms.description: A damp cobbled square ringed by leaning timber houses. A cracked fountain gurgles in the middle. The tavern lies east, a general store west, the old road runs north, a flight of worn steps climbing to the clocktower hall, and a mossy stair descends into the dark to the south. A hedge witch has set up a stall under the fountain, selling lessons in basic magic.

rooms.name: The Drowned Lantern
rooms.description: Smoke, spilled ale, and low voices. A barkeep polishes the same mug he has been polishing for years. A trapdoor behind the bar stands open, with a faint smell of cheese. The barkeep sells food and drink.

npcs.name: The barkeep
npcs.description: He has been polishing the same mug for years.

npcs.name: Brenna the barmaid
npcs.description: A barmaid of formidable presence and legendary tip-jar discipline.

npcs.name: Ozzie Plumb
npcs.description: A sunken-eyed hedge-wizard slumped in the corner, with an anxious young apprentice named Timbles.

rooms.name: The Old Road
rooms.description: Rutted and overgrown, the road bends away into pine forest. Something rustles in the ditch.

rooms.name: Crypt Steps
rooms.description: Worn steps lead down into a flooded passage that smells of old stone and older water.

rooms.name: Mossgate General Store
rooms.description: Shelves of everything a hero might need and several things they won't. The shopkeeper watches you with the calm of a person who has seen adventurers come and go, mostly go.

rooms.name: Hall of Second Chances
rooms.description: A hushed, candle-lit hall under the clocktower where the fallen wake with ringing ears and a headache. A sign reads: 'DEATH IS A SCHEDULING CONFLICT. YOUR BELONGINGS ARE WHERE YOU LEFT THEM.' Steps lead back down to the square.
